subject.title: Session transcript doomloop: crash-restart cycle inflates transcript until gateway OOMs

question: Which default recovery policy should OpenClaw use when an active session transcript is too large or unsafe to load on gateway restart?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the permanent behavior affects persisted user session state and needs a human choice between preserving, truncating, quarantining, rotating, or skipping degraded transcripts.

options.title: Define Pre-Open Recovery Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and choose a default recovery path before landing code that changes persisted transcript handling.

options.title: Land Bootstrap Cap Only
options.body: Treat the open bootstrap-marker PR as a partial mitigation while leaving transcript-size and degraded-reload recovery tracked here.

options.title: Split Raw Transcript Maintenance
options.body: Move active transcript byte/line caps to the separate session-maintenance tracker while keeping this issue focused on crash-restart recovery.

recommendation.title: Define Pre-Open Recovery Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and choose a default recovery path before landing code that changes persisted transcript handling.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent current-path owner from blame/history on the active runner, repair, session-manager, and bootstrap surfaces.
